title: A Orchard for the Postcard
author: Lior Pemberton
blurb: Wren Thackeray, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
